sentences.text: Mr. Sunshine is an American television sitcom that aired from February 9 to April 6 , 2011 , as a mid-season replacement .	mid-season replacement	mid-season replacement
The single-camera comedy was co-created by Matthew Perry , who also starred in the series .	Matthew Perry	Matthew Perry	single-camera	Single-camera setup
